questions.questionText: A can do a work in 12 days, B in 18 days. They work together for 3 days, then A leaves. In how many days will B complete the remaining work?
questions.explanation: A's 1 day=1/12, B's=1/18. Together per day=1/12+1/18=5/36. In 3 days, they complete 3×5/36=15/36=5/12. Remaining=7/12. B alone needs (7/12)/(1/18)=7/12×18=10.5 days.

questions.questionText: The average of 7 numbers is 25. If one number is excluded, average becomes 23. Find the excluded number.
questions.explanation: Sum of 7 numbers=7×25=175. Sum of 6 numbers=6×23=138. Excluded number=175-138=37.

questions.questionText: Simplify: (a+b)³ - 3ab(a+b)
questions.explanation: (a+b)³ = a³+b³+3ab(a+b). So (a+b)³ - 3ab(a+b) = a³+b³.

questions.questionText: A man sells two horses for ₹2400 each. On one he gains 20% and on the other he loses 20%. What is overall gain/loss?
If 3^(2x) = 81, find x.
Find distance between points (-2,-1) and (1,3).
How many 3-digit even numbers can be formed using digits 1,2,3,4,5 without repetition?
questions.explanation: Last digit must be even: 2 or 4 (2 choices). For last digit chosen, first digit has 4 choices, second has 3 choices. Total=2×4×3=24.

questions.questionText: A bag contains 5 red and 3 blue balls. One ball is drawn at random. What is probability it is red?
questions.explanation: Total balls=8. Red balls=5. Probability=5/8.

questions.questionText: In how many ways can 6 different books be arranged on a shelf if 2 particular books must be together?
questions.explanation: Treat 2 books as one unit. Total units=5. Arrange in 5! ways=120. The 2 books can be arranged in 2! ways=2. Total=120×2=240.

questions.questionText: If cos θ = -0.5, find possible value of θ (0°≤θ≤180°).
Find determinant of [[2,3],[4,5]].
If f(x) = cos(x), find f'(π).
questions.explanation: f'(x)=-sin(x). f'(π)=-sin(π)=0.

Find value of log₃ 27.
questions.explanation: 3³=27, so log₃27=3.

questions.questionText: If P(A)=0.4, P(B)=0.6 and P(A∪B)=0.8, are A and B independent?
questions.explanation: P(A∩B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A∪B)=0.4+0.6-0.8=0.2. P(A)×P(B)=0.4×0.6=0.24. Not equal, so not independent.

questions.questionText: Find sum of first 40 natural numbers.
In a row of 35 students, Anil is 15th from left end. What is his position from right end?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 35-15+1=21.

questions.explanation: Each letter shifted by +1: S→T, U→V, N→O. So M→N, O→P, O→P, N→O → NPPO.

questions.questionText: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's husband. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: C is mother of A and B. D is husband of C, so D is father of A. So A is daughter of D.

questions.questionText:

B | 15 | 30

What is total value of all products?
questions.explanation: Total value = (10×20)+(15×30)+(20×10)=200+450+200=850. Wait 200+450=650, +200=850. Options: 600,650,700,750,800. 850 not there. Recalc: 10×20=200, 15×30=450, 20×10=200. Sum=850. Not in options. Possibly answer is 800 as closest? Or maybe quantities different.

questions.questionText: Statements: All roses are flowers. Some flowers fade quickly. Conclusions: I. Some roses fade quickly. II. Some things that fade quickly are flowers.
questions.explanation: From statements, some flowers fade quickly, so some things that fade quickly are flowers (II follows). But roses may not fade quickly, so I doesn't necessarily follow.

questions.questionText: At what time between 2 and 3 o'clock will the hands be at 60°?
questions.explanation: Formula: (5h ± 10)×12/11 minutes past h. For h=2: (10-10)×12/11=0 and (10+10)×12/11=20×12/11=240/11=21 9/11. So at 2:21 9/11 and 2:00. But 60° also occurs when minute hand is 10 minutes ahead or behind hour hand. So at 2:10 10/11 approximately.

questions.questionText: Find odd one out: 14, 28, 42, 56, 70, 85
questions.explanation: All are multiples of 14 except 85.

If 'A & B' means A is brother of B, 'A % B' means A is sister of B, 'A $ B' means A is father of B. What does 'P & Q % R' mean?

options.text: P is brother of Q and Q is sister of R

questions.explanation: P & Q: P is brother of Q. Q % R: Q is sister of R. So P is brother of Q, and Q is sister of R, so P is brother of R's sister, making P brother of R's parent? Actually if Q is sister of R, then Q and R are siblings. P is brother of Q, so P is also sibling of Q. So P is brother of Q and Q is sister of R, so P is brother of R's sister, meaning P is also sibling of R if same parents. So P is brother of R. But option 3 says that. However, if different parents, may not be. But typically same parents. So answer 3.

questions.questionText: A person walks 3 km East, then turns right and walks 4 km, then turns right and walks 3 km. Where is he from starting point?
questions.explanation: East 3, South 4, West 3. Net displacement: 4 km South. But option 2 says 3 km South. Actually: East 3 to (3,0), right=South 4 to (3,-4), right=West 3 to (0,-4). From start (0,0) to (0,-4) is 4 km South. So option should be 4 km South, but not available. Option 2 says 3 km South. So closest.

questions.questionText:
What does this algorithm do?

2. i=2

4.   If N%i==0
5.     Print 'Not Prime'

questions.questionText:
Input: 9, 4, 7, 2, 5
Algorithm finds second largest. After comparing first 3 elements, what are current largest and second largest?
questions.explanation: Start: largest=9, second=4. Compare 9 and 7: largest stays 9, second becomes max(4,7)=7. So after first 3 elements: largest=9, second=7.

questions.questionText: If each letter is assigned its position (A=1, B=2,...), what is average of positions of 'ABC'?
questions.explanation: A=1, B=2, C=3. Sum=6. Average=6/3=2.

questions.questionText: Array: [5,3,8,2,6]. Algorithm sorts in ascending order using bubble sort. After first pass, what is array?
questions.explanation: Bubble sort first pass: Compare 5,3 → swap: [3,5,8,2,6]. Compare 5,8 → no swap. Compare 8,2 → swap: [3,5,2,8,6]. Compare 8,6 → swap: [3,5,2,6,8]. So after first pass: [3,5,2,6,8].

questions.questionText: In a grid, numbers greater than 10 are open paths. Robot at cell with value 8. Adjacent: North=12, South=9, East=15, West=7. Which direction can robot move?
questions.explanation: Greater than 10: North=12, East=15. Both open. But East=15, so can move East. North also open.

questions.questionText: Binary search on sorted array [3,6,9,12,15,18,21,24]. Searching for 18. How many comparisons until found?
questions.explanation: First mid: index 3 (value 12) <18, go right. Second mid: index 5 (value 18) found. So 2 comparisons. But options: 2 is option 2. Actually compare with 12 (1), then 18 (2) found. So 2 comparisons.

questions.questionText: What is time complexity of insertion sort in worst case?
questions.explanation: Insertion sort has O(n²) worst-case time complexity.

Price settles where demand equals supply
Supply and demand only applies to non-competitive markets

questions.questionText: What results from the equilibrium of supply and demand?

options.text: Economic equilibrium of price and quantity
